domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to inspect. Full URLs are accepted and reduced to their hostname, and a leading www. is stripped. Wire this to the output of another Actor for bulk enrichment.

includeSsl.title: Inspect SSL certificate
includeSsl.description: Open a TLS connection on port 443 to read the certificate issuer, validity window and days remaining. Adds roughly 0.3-1s per domain.

includeRdap.title: Look up registrar via RDAP
includeRdap.description: Query rdap.org for registrar, registration date, domain age and expiry. RDAP is the IETF successor to WHOIS: free and keyless. Adds roughly 0.3-1s per domain.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many domains to process in parallel. Keep at or below 10 so RDAP does not rate-limit you.
